description_en: Queries the log field configuration for a protected object
description_zh: 查询防护对象的日志字段配置
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-resource-log-field-config --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-zpr30000000 --delivery-type sls --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --resource test.waf.com-waf --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeResourceLogFieldConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Web Application Firewall (WAF) instance.

Call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html operation to query the ID of the WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html接口查看当前WAF实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The log delivery type. Valid values:

sls: Simple Log Service.

kafka: Kafka.

syslog: Syslog
parameters.help_zh:
日志投递类型。取值：

sls： 表示阿里云日志服务。
kafka：表示外发投递到kafka日志。
syslog：表示外发投递到syslog日志
parameters.name: delivery_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group to which the WAF instance belongs
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance resides. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The protected object whose log field configuration you want to query
parameters.name: resource

AddList.description_en: The extra log fields that are configured in addition to the default log fields. The fields are specified as a string of comma-separated values
AddList.description_zh: 除默认日志字段外，额外配置的日志字段列表，使用"a,b,c,……"格式表示

DelList.description_en: The log fields that are removed from the default log fields. The fields are specified as a string of comma-separated values
DelList.description_zh: 相对于默认日志字段，少配置的日志字段列表，使用"a,b,c,……"格式表示

DeliveryType.description_en:
The log delivery type. Valid values:

sls: Simple Log Service.

kafka: Kafka.

syslog: Syslog
DeliveryType.description_zh:
日志投递类型。取值：

sls： 表示阿里云日志服务。
kafka：表示外发投递到kafka日志。
syslog：表示外发投递到syslog日志

ExtendConfig.description_en:
The extended configuration for log delivery. The value is a string that is converted from a JSON object of parameters.

For more information about the parameters, see the description of the ExtendConfig parameter in [ModifyResourceLogFieldConfig](~~ModifyResourceLogFieldConfig~~)
ExtendConfig.description_zh:
日志投递扩展配置。以一系列参数构造的 JSON 格式转化成字符串。
详细参数信息，请参见[ModifyResourceLogFieldConfig](~~ModifyResourceLogFieldConfig~~)接口的日志投递扩展配置（ExtendConfig）参数描述

FieldList.description_en: The list of delivered log fields. The fields are specified as a string of comma-separated values
FieldList.description_zh: 投递的日志字段列表，使用"a,b,c,……"格式表示

LogDeliveryStrategy.description_en:
The log delivery policies. Multiple policies are supported. The value is a string that is converted from a JSON array of parameters.

For more information about the parameters, see the description of the LogDeliveryStrategy parameter in [ModifyResourceLogFieldConfig](~~ModifyResourceLogFieldConfig~~)
LogDeliveryStrategy.description_zh:
日志投递策略，支持多个策略。以一系列参数构造的 JSON 数组格式转化成字符串。

详细参数信息，请参见[ModifyResourceLogFieldConfig](~~ModifyResourceLogFieldConfig~~)接口的日志投递策略（LogDeliveryStrategy）参数描述
